property_summary: For any non-zero target address, calling transfer on C should never succeed (return true) when the target is the contract itself because the reference rejects address(this) in validAddress; the mutant that removes that check can allow transfer to succeed when passed address(this), so there exist inputs (target == address(c)) where mutant returns true but reference always forbids it.

For every input the reference contract C rejects using its own address as the target (the modifier causes transfer(...) to revert when contract_address == address(c)), so any successful call-return observable from c.transfer for target == address(c) must be impossible in the reference but may succeed in the mutant that removed that check.
